retrieval_policy: Resolve and save the task list plus split indices at preparation time; record retrieval UTC timestamp and raw metadata hashes.

suites.split: 30 one-repeat 10-fold tasks and 5 ten-repeat 10-fold tasks in the live manifest
suites.prose_discrepancy: The paper and suite prose describe 33% holdouts above 10000 rows; the live task definitions use cross-validation and are authoritative for reproducing published experiments.
